subject: PCL and read.config files help in R

messages.author: 61f0368da705b77a
messages.subject: PCL and read.config files help in R
parts:
Hi all,

I'm new to Maaslin. I have combined my abundance and metadata into one file (leaf traits.txt) and I've made my read.contig file. I'm unsure as to how to proceed next. 

I've installed the packages needed for Maaslin, as well as Maaslin itself (attached R script). the website says that I need to transpose my PCL file (leaf traits.txt?) to a TSV files (I thought my .txt file was a TSV file). 

How do I go about changing my .txt file into a TSV file? And when I run the code below: 

library(Maaslin)
Maaslin('leaf traits.tsv','maaslin_output',strInputConfig='leaf traits.read.config')



I receive the following message:



Error in file(file, "r") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In file(file, "r") :
  cannot open file 'leaf traits.read.config': No such file or directory


Any help would be greatly appreciated :)

Cheers,
Peter

messages.author: 3bf2dfbdb300e013
messages.subject: Re: PCL and read.config files help in R
parts:
Hi Peter,

Changing the .txt extension is as simple as changing the name manually in Mac (see attached), but I am not sure how to do it in a non-Mac computer. Regarding your specific analysis, you do not need to create a config file anymore as you can specify your last metadata row or column (depending on TSV or PCL input) using iLastMetadata parameter in your Maaslin run (example below). I ran the code below for your data which worked fine on my end. Let me know if it resolves the issue on your end as well.

Maaslin('leaf_traits.tsv','maaslin_output', iLastMetadata = 10)

Many thanks,
Himel
